Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview scheduled for today (10:30am)

Hi Jordan / Laura —

I'm really sorry for the short notice but I woke up with a fever and chills and don't want to risk being on video (and potentially contagious). I can still do a very short phone screen later today if that's helpful (around 4–5pm PT), otherwise I'm happy to pick another day next week.

I attached my resume in case you need it for panelists. Thanks for understanding.

—Noah

Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Interview scheduled for today (10:30am) — Noah is unwell

Folks — forwarding Noah's note. Today's loop with Noah (10:30am PT) is at risk; Laura, do you want to try the same-day short phone window he suggested (4–5pm), or should we split the panel and record a shorter session so we can still collect signals?

Options I see:
- Option A: Short 20–25m phone at 4:30pm with Vivek + Mina Qs (no slides). Jordan to host and take notes.
- Option B: Cancel today and reschedule for next week (Laura to propose 2 slots).
- Option C: Keep original slots but have someone else flip in later this week (not ideal).

If we go with any live conversation today, we need consent to record (we have standard consent text attached). Mina — can you cover a short behavioral + system-design check if needed? Vivek — any objections to a compressed conversation for initial signal?

—Jordan
[Attachment: interview_panel_instructions.pdf (pdf); recording_consent.txt (txt)]

I'm fine with either Option A or B. Two practical notes:
- If we do Option A (same-day phone at 4:30pm), I can put up a 25-minute invite for Vivek + Mina and I'll include a brief rubric so we can score consistently. Please reply here if 4:30pm PT works for you. We will ask for verbal recording consent at the start.
- If we reschedule, I'm holding these two windows for Noah next week: Tue 4/14 10:30–11:30am PT, Thu 4/16 3:00–5:00pm PT. I can open both and confirm once Noah picks.

For the compressed interview, we'll focus on: 5m intro, 10m product/behavior, 10m technical (system-design high level). Mina — can you gate the technical portion to be high-level architecture rather than deep whiteboard?

—Laura
